implementation: A generated from-scratch AC1021 drawing contains an explicit LTYPE and referencing LINE. The test verifies the actual binary signature when requested, imports via RS_FilterDXFRW, edits pattern/description, exports through LibreCAD, checks the emitted LTYPE and LINE reference, and reimports. The same test includes an ASCII source control. Both destination exports are ASCII, as selected by the application.
validation: The focused generated ASCII/Binary source test passed 32 assertions with both installed-current and bundled codecs.
The existing [ltype]~[dwg] fast selection now includes the new test: installed-current 16 cases/3844 assertions and bundled 27 cases/4065 assertions pass.
The test-only patch applies with --unidiff-zero after all 39 earlier patches, and the resulting test file is byte-identical to the committed candidate.
Source-release inventory generation/check pass for 1245 files and its 18-control self-test passes. No DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
limits: Same-library generated AC1021 inputs and one simple explicit LTYPE/LINE do not establish independent producer semantics, complex LTYPE or other version coverage, binary output, GUI or non-macOS behavior. The consumer candidate remains unmerged. No phase gate or support claim is promoted.
